mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (as indicated by the current value) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both labor market participation (PAYEMS) and housing demand (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both PAYEMS and HOUST decline, or the joint Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (as indicated by the current value of HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high HOUST periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 102 (as indicated by the current value) signals weakening manufacturing activity and reduced corporate output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 102, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime (HOUST > 1500), strong housing demand drives economic expansion and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in the unemployment rate signals a 'soft landing' scenario where the Fed tightens without causing a recession, boosting corporate profit outlook and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the joint Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
